name: etherpad
title: Etherpad
description: Text editor in the browser that several people type in at the same time, with a colour per author, a time slider through every change and a chat beside the pad. Anyone who can open it can make and edit pads; the pads are kept in PostgreSQL. After deploying, open it and name your first pad; the admin page at /admin takes the user admin and the password you set below.

variables.name: ETHERPAD_TITLE
variables.label: Title
variables.description: The name shown in the browser tab

variables.name: ETHERPAD_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: For the user admin on the page /admin (settings and plugins)

variables.name: ETHERPAD_PUBLIC_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://pad.example.com. The sign-in for the admin page and for API clients is tied to it. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above

variables.name: ETHERPAD_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: ETHERPAD_SSO_ADMIN_SECRET
variables.label: Sign-in secret (admin)
variables.description: Client secret of the built-in sign-in for the admin page. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: ETHERPAD_SSO_USER_SECRET
variables.label: Sign-in secret (users)
variables.description: Client secret of the built-in sign-in for API clients. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy
